fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at c404b4730, scratch-built rhiza: run note journals with role/leaf/session from env (role-only and leaf-only too), via --run, --json and api call run.note -; run status human '## Notes' and --json notes oldest first; empty, spaces-only, \n, \r, 201 chars, missing and extra args exit 2 with nothing journalled (200 x and 200 é accepted, tab accepted); no RHIZA_RUN names RHIZA_RUN; unknown run exit 4; --dry-run writes nothing. Scoped tests internal/run TestNote, internal/api TestRunNote, TestScripts/run-note and describe-golden pass.

QA cycle 2 at c404b4730, scratch-built rhiza driving a leaves run with fake rex/claude: a verifier that journals two findings (multi-line with trailing newline, 200+ chars with leading/trailing spaces) and then exits 1 gives the attempt-2 builder a prompt quoting both byte for byte with the inspect-the-working-tree and address-every-finding-exactly-as-written lines (the cycle-1 qa f1 is fixed); a verifier ending with neither gives a retry quoting 'verifier failed: verifier ended with neither Evidence nor findings' and no findings list; attempt 1 has no retry section; three failures give no fourth builder, the leaf fails and attempt 3 quotes attempt 2's findings. TestLeafPrompt and internal/run TestLeaves pass.

QA cycle 2 at c404b4730, same scratch leaves run: builder and verifier prompts after notes were journalled end with 'Notes from earlier sessions of this run:' and '- <note>' lines oldest first (retry prompts after the retry section); the first builder, with no notes, has no heading; rhiza run spawn children: builder and verifier brief.md carry both notes oldest first after the caller's brief (one with no trailing newline), check-plan, critic and fixer briefs carry none. TestLeafPrompt|TestRunSpawn, TestRenderSpawnBrief and TestScripts/run-spawn pass.

QA cycle 2 at c404b4730, scratch-built rhiza guide: builder and verifier carry `rhiza run note "<learning>"` before session done; builder carries update-the-landed-node-with-rhiza-set-or-raise-a-question; build-retry says findings are quoted verbatim in the prompt; conduct says the retry brief quotes findings verbatim and inspects the working tree; verifier keeps 'Never edit code'; check-*, critic, plan-critic and fixer topics tell no session to journal a note (checks name run notes only in their unchanged never-read rule). internal/guide tests and internal/api TestGuideInstall pass.
